verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is a locally installed desktop operating system, not a hosted service. Choosing a storage region or data-residency location is a cloud/SaaS axis that does not apply to this kind of product. The evidence about data ownership ("your data belongs to you") and optional online accounts concerns adjacent privacy posture and third-party providers, not a product-provided region choice, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
